artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a complex Banach space and let $(T(t))_{t\ge 0}$ be a bounded $C_0$-semigroup on $X$ with infinitesimal generator $A$. Assume that the spectrum of $A$ does not meet the imaginary axis, i.e. $\sigma(A)\cap i\mathbb{R}=\emptyset$, and that there exists $\alpha>0$ such that the resolvent satisfies
$$\|(is-A)^{-1}\|=O(|s|^{\alpha})\quad\text{as }|s|\to\infty.$$
It is known that under these hypotheses
$$\|T(t)A^{-1}\|=O\!\left(\frac{\log(t)^{1/\alpha}}{t^{1/\alpha}}\right)\quad\text{as }t\to\infty,$$
and that on Hilbert spaces the logarithmic factor can be removed.

Determine an exponent $\beta\in[0,1]$, depending only on geometric properties of $X$ such as its Fourier type, type, or cotype, for which the refined estimate
$$\|T(t)A^{-1}\|=O\!\left(\frac{\log(t)^{\beta/\alpha}}{t^{1/\alpha}}\right)\quad\text{as }t\to\infty$$
holds. In particular, identify the optimal value of $\beta$ in terms of these geometric invariants of $X$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (e.g. on sharp growth rates for semigroups using resolvent bounds, and on relations between resolvent decay and semigroup growth) establishes the standard $\log(t)^{1/\alpha}/t^{1/\alpha}$ bound on general Banach spaces and the logarithm-free bound on Hilbert spaces, but a precise determination of an intermediate exponent $\beta\in[0,1]$ tied to the Fourier type / type / cotype of $X$ does not appear to be available in the literature; the question is posed as an open problem and no published resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Sharp growth rates for semigroups using resolvent bounds
status_evidence.snippet: Proves resolvent-based growth rates for semigroups, with refined results on Hilbert spaces, asymptotically analytic semigroups, and positive semigroups on L^p or C(K).
status_evidence.claim: State-of-the-art results give the logarithmic bound on general Banach spaces and remove the log on Hilbert and certain other spaces, but do not pin down an intermediate exponent based on Fourier type/cotype.

status_evidence.title: Relation between semigroup growth and resolvent decay
status_evidence.snippet: Studies how decay of the resolvent on the imaginary axis controls semigroup growth on Banach spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2025) work continues to investigate Banach-space versions of the Batty–Duyckaerts type theorem, indicating the geometric refinement remains under investigation.

status_evidence.title: Fine scales of decay of operator semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: Develops fine-scale (regularly varying) versions of decay/growth estimates for operator semigroups.
status_evidence.claim: Fine scales are studied but the dependence of the logarithmic exponent on the geometry of X (Fourier type, type, cotype) is not resolved.
